propositions: The documentation link checker must enforce top-level docs index membership as a separate rule while validating repository-relative Markdown links deterministically.

The checker must scan inline Markdown links and images outside fenced blocks and inline code, resolving relative targets from source directories and permitting targets anywhere in the repository while rejecting escaped targets.

The parser must strip query strings and fragments before file resolution, ignore scheme-qualified and fragment-only targets, and produce deterministic findings with source path, line number, raw target, normalized path, and failure reason.

The maintained documentation boundary includes root Markdown, .agents, .github, docs, examples/agent-skills, infra, src/rebar/_guides, src/rebar/llm/eval_specs, templates, and specified test fixture directories while excluding .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, src/rebar/llm/reviewers, and hidden root files.
The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve must be replaced with the unified checker API and behavior documented in docs/documentation-policy.md.
Excluded Markdown sources must remain valid link targets from included sources, and all existing top-level docs index behavior must be retained.
